data.response:
**Pick Rossi Idraulica.** 3,950 EUR incl. VAT vs 4,148 EUR for TermoCasa, double the warranty, and Marta already knows your install. The one thing that would flip it is timing, if you need heat sooner.

| | Rossi Idraulica | TermoCasa |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Boiler | Vaillant ecoTEC plus 30 kW | Baxi Duo-tec 28 kW |
| Total incl. VAT | **3,950 EUR** | 4,148 EUR (3,400 + 22%) |
| Warranty | 10 yr, needs yearly service | 5 yr |
| Timing | Two weeks | Next week |

Why Rossi:
- 198 EUR cheaper once VAT is counted, and the only quote that explicitly includes removing the old unit.
- Same brand you already run (Vaillant ecoTEC plus since 2019), and she is the one already servicing it, next due 2026-11-14.
- Caveat: the 10 year warranty is conditional on annual servicing, so ask her yearly service price before signing.

Two things to verify in writing: whether the 22% VAT on the TermoCasa quote is right (at a 10% renovation rate it drops to 3,740 EUR and wins on price), and whether either price covers the expansion vessel Marta suspects is causing your 0.8 bar drops, plus a flush.

Report saved to `Projects/Research/2026-10-14-0414-boiler-quote-comparison.md` and attached as a file.
